items.name: keyline
items.title: Keyline
items.description: Keyline tokens and construction primitives: role weights, the optional cut (--kl-cut), cells, flood, lamp, unfold, dock, pending. Source tokens go to your :root and .dark; theme/tokens.ts holds them as data.
items.docs: Shape: square by default (--kl-cut: 0). Set --kl-cut to 0.5 (quiet) or 1 (full) on :root or any subtree for the cut accent, or use data-kl-cut="quiet" | "on" | "off". Density: data-kl-density="compact". Reduced motion: honours prefers-reduced-motion; data-kl-motion="reduce" forces it.

light.kl-font: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-yellow: oklch(from var(--kl-working) calc(l - 0.04 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * (1 - 0.06 * var(--kl-dark))) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-data-2: oklch(from var(--kl-cobalt) calc(l + 0.18 + 0.02 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * 0.5) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-hatch:
repeating-linear-gradient(
      -45deg,
      transparent 0 5px,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--kl-ink) 14%, transparent) 5px 6px
    )

.kl-frame, .kl-ctl.clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-frame:is([dir=\"rtl\"], [dir=\"rtl\".clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(100% - var(--kl-c) - var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-flood:is( [data-kl-on], :not([data-k.transition:
background-color 0s linear var(--kl-t-flood),
      color 0s linear calc(var(--kl-t-flood) * 0.4)

Keyline adds: the place also holds when content above changes size (in every engine), arrivals unfold from their top keyline while the reader follows, and a Latest cell that counts what arrived below and jumps a bounded, interruptible distance. The log scrolls inside Keyline's Scroll Area, so its bar is the shared one; the jump reveals it, and pressing it is the reader taking over.

items.description: A native scroll container with Keyline scrollbars (Base UI Scroll Area): a bar is a cell on the region's edge, owning its seam; content is padded only while an axis overflows; corner cell for both bars; focusable viewport with an inset ring. The thumb reveals while its axis scrolls and when the pointer is on the bar, widens and darkens there, inks while held, then fades (overlay platforms; always shown where native bars take space, in forced colours and for more contrast).
items.docs: Size the root (height or max-height) with your own class: <ScrollArea className="h-64" label="Activity">…</ScrollArea>. scrollbars="vertical" (default), "horizontal" or "both". Scrolling stays native (wheel, trackpad, touch, keyboard). Give label when nothing else names the region; the viewport is focusable while it overflows. Do not wrap Select or Multiselect lists in it: they keep their own native scroller, styled to match.
